newsitem.title: UK: Monument Derivatives to buy London Bond Broking.
newsitem.headline: Monument Derivatives to buy London Bond Broking.

text.p: Monument Derivatives said on Wednesday it would complete the purchase of the London Bond Broking Company (LBB) by the end of the month.
Martin Burton, managing director of Monument told Reuters that LBB will be a wholly owned fixed income division of Monument from November 1. LBB will retain its name.
Burton declined to disclose the cost of the purchase.
He said Albert E Sharp, which held 55 percent of LBB, had initiated the move.
"Previously, Monument has not held a research department, " said Burton.
"Through acquiring LBB we will be able to extend our products and our client base as well as offering a fuller service to our existing customers."
Burton said Sharp, having nursed LBB through the embryonic stage, felt that the company needed further development it could not provide.
Monument currently has 22 staff, and will add seven from LBB. Company sources said those staff not part of the merger had already been informed and had left.
Jobs cut were in the sales and trading sections, where positions overlapped with those at Monument, sources at LBB said.
Burton said the high profile of Stephen Lewis, director of research at LBB, would be an asset to Monument and he expected Lewis's new role would cover both Monument and LBB.
